sources.title: Clearline AI
sources.snippet: Faster, scalable clearance analysis for electrical utilities. ClearLine uses a physics-aware AI model to predict conductor position under any loading condition — temperature, wind, and span geometry — in seconds. Trained on real LiDAR and engineering data, ClearLine delivers the accuracy of finite-element analysis at a fraction of the time and cost.
